surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe input cost surges, labor agitation, and liquidity pressures ahead of Diwali.
what_changed: Yarn prices surged by 45% to 66%, triggering early Diwali shutdown threats and loom unit closures [1b54f570ed7b, b567711c9ed4, b62552cc0c7d].
Weavers instituted a two-day weekly holiday and strict 15-day yarn payment terms ahead of Diwali [0c72a246c955].
Labor agitation and leave disputes among embroidery workers resulted in strikes, police cases, and reverse migration [d6a4b0e6a74b, 6b7974c7f88e].
stress_signals: Multiple cheating, fraud, and payment default cases reported across yarn, fabric, and diamond segments [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, 2718cba9f837].
Yarn price hike and mandatory 15-day payment rules compressing upstream working capital [b62552cc0c7d, 0c72a246c955].
Labor strikes and 'Gaon Chalo' protests triggering early worker exodus and operational disruption [d6a4b0e6a74b, 73dfcce5d3f4].
Textile industry hit by pre-Diwali recessionary pressures and transportation bottlenecks [d1f9f2e9444f, 28ff6df05700].
improvement_signals: Diamond sector shortening its traditional Diwali vacation due to improved demand, raising hopes of wage cut rollbacks [ff0f473e0921, 2b47ff4fa01a].
Adoption of advanced technologies and positive business creation via MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs [7eaa09c3357d, 7dc3005e0b28].
High-altitude success for Surat-made fabric-coated airships in border surveillance [967bbbed3d39].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital drawdowns and repayment delays among upstream weaving and loom units facing strict 15-day yarn credit terms.
Track resolution of labor disputes and worker absenteeism following the recent strikes and court petitions.
Evaluate post-Diwali inventory pile-ups and actual demand recovery in both MMF textiles and diamond sectors.
